title: Journal spec
description: Intent, flow and transitions for a journal, its parts and its posts (journal -> parts -> posts). One file per journal, at _journals/<journal>/journal-spec.json, authored before any prose. It is the authority for each post's intent, thesis and role; the post spec copies those and adds the post's internal structure.

basis.description: For a spec written after the prose: what it was reconstructed from and how far the reconstruction goes.

intent.description: The reader outcome of the whole journal. The audience is required here and inherited by every part and post that does not narrow it.

thesis.description: The journal's central claim and the supporting claims its parts are responsible for.

flow.description: The pattern that orders the parts.

parts.description: The parts in reading order. This order must equal the order of sections in config.yaml. A journal without parts has exactly one part.

post_kind.description: What kind of page a post is. Kinds that carry structure rather than argument (part_intro, front_matter, reference) may have an empty role.supports and are exempt from the orphan check.

title.description: Must equal the section title in config.yaml.

thesis.description: The part's claim. A full part gives the complete thesis with supporting claims for its posts; an outline part gives the question and the claim.

role.description: What the part contributes to the journal thesis; supports lists the journal's supporting claims.

flow.description: The pattern that orders the part's posts.

transition_in.description: The link from the previous part into this one. Required on every part except the first.

posts.description: The posts in reading order. This order must equal the order of the section's posts in config.yaml.

folder.description: The post folder under posts/, as listed in config.yaml without '/index.md'.

question.description: The question the post answers. Present even at outline level, so the hierarchy can be checked for gaps before any post is specified in full.

thesis.description: The post's claim. Its supporting claims are declared in the post spec, where the sections that argue for them live.

role.description: What the post contributes to the part thesis; supports lists the part's supporting claims.

transition_in.description: The link from the previous post of the same part into this one. Required on every full post except the first of its part; the first post is reached through the part's own transition_in.

post_spec.description: Path of the post spec, relative to the journal directory (posts/<folder>/spec.json).
